name: Grippa
tagline: Payroll for people who spent last night rigging a crane over a lake.
positioning: Grippa runs payroll, timecards, and residual math for film and episodic crews without the fax machine energy of legacy payroll houses.

hero.h1: Payroll that survives a night shoot.
hero.sub: Grippa handles union rates, meal penalties, kit fees, and 14-hour turnarounds across every state your production accidentally shot in — before the wrap party ends.

features.title: Timecards that read a call sheet
features.description: Turnaround, golden hours, and forced calls calculate themselves. Your 2nd AD stops doing spreadsheet math at 2am and your accountant stops crying at 3am.

features.title: Every guild, one engine
features.description: IATSE, DGA, WGA, SAG-AFTRA, Teamsters — rate tables, fringes, and pension/health caps stay current so you don't audit yourself into a coma.

features.title: Multi-state, multi-loan-out chaos
features.description: Loan-outs, incentives, and residency rules across 30 jurisdictions reconcile per production. We do the withholding gymnastics, you take the credit.

features.title: Start work in minutes
features.description: Digital start paperwork, I-9s, and deal memos that crew actually finish because it's not a 40-page PDF from 2004.

features.title: Cost reports producers trust
features.description: Hot costs and Hollywood-format cost reports export straight to your production accounting stack — no re-keying, no vibes-based estimates.

features.title: Audit-proof, on purpose
features.description: Every rate decision, edit, and approval is stamped and searchable, so the post-strike wage audit is a Tuesday, not an event.

testimonials.quote: We wrapped a 62-day episodic across three states and nobody rage-quit accounting. Grippa closed the payroll week before I finished my coffee — which, for context, was a large.
testimonials.name: Danielle Prewitt

testimonials.quote: Our old payroll house billed us for the privilege of losing a timecard. Grippa's usage pricing means we pay for actual crew weeks, not a vendor's boat payment.
testimonials.name: Marcus Oyelaran

testimonials.quote: Meal penalty disputes used to eat a full day per week. Now the numbers just show up correct, which is somehow more unsettling than the chaos was.
testimonials.name: Regina Falco

pricing.blurb: For features, commercials, and shoots that end before you go feral.
For episodic and slate volume where the weeks add up fast.
For studios and networks running many productions at once.

homepage.footerBlurb: Grippa is production payroll built by people who've been on set at hour 15. Fewer faxes, correct meal penalties, calmer accountants.
